import sys,time,json,hashlib,shutil,os
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'tools/verification')
from verify_thermal_scale import run_process_group
root=Path('outputs/native-flow/pressure-fixed-point');previous=Path('outputs/native-flow/aggregation-refresh');records=[]
for name in ['circle-new','n100','n200','n320']:
 base=next(r for r in json.loads((previous/'runs.json').read_text()) if r['name']==name)
 cmd=base['command'].copy();cmd[2]='build/cartmesh2d_flow_cli';prefix=root/name/'flow';prefix.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);cmd[cmd.index('--output')+1]=str(prefix)
 if shutil.disk_usage('.').free<1.5*1024**3:raise RuntimeError('disk floor')
 start=time.monotonic();r=run_process_group(cmd,root/name/'run',300);r['elapsedSeconds']=time.monotonic()-start;r['name']=name;r['baseline']=base
 records.append(r);(root/'runs.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2));print(name,r['status'],r['elapsedSeconds'],flush=True)
 if r['returncode']!=0:break
 matched=[]
 for suffix in ['.cells.csv','.faces.csv','.fields.json','.vtk','.residuals.csv','.checkpoint','.time-history.csv','.json']:
  p=Path(str(prefix)+suffix);old=previous/name/p.name
  digest=lambda x:hashlib.sha256(x.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
  if not p.exists():continue
  same=digest(p)==digest(old);matched.append({'suffix':suffix,'sha256':digest(p),'identical':same})
  if same:
   temp=p.with_name(p.name+'.dedup');os.link(old,temp);os.replace(temp,p)
 r['comparison']=matched;(root/'runs.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2));print(name,'identical',all(x['identical'] for x in matched),flush=True)
 mesh=cmd[cmd.index('--mesh')+1]
 audit=run_process_group([sys.executable,'tools/verification/verify_transient_flow.py','--mesh',mesh,'--prefix',str(prefix),'--output',str(root/name/'audit.json')],root/name/'audit-run',120)
 print(name,'audit',audit['status'],flush=True)
 if audit['returncode']!=0:break
